# FormatToPortWait

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Unpacks the registers of a receive on a port.

!!! info "Library helper"
    Implemented in `zuzu.h` on top of the syscalls; it has no syscall number of its own.

```c
PortWaitResult FormatToPortWait(SvcResult r);
```

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `r` | in | Result of WaitOn() or ReplyRecv() on a port. |

## Returns

The status, the sender's marker, the message length and any granted handle.
